newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Citibank NZ posts NZ$3.17 mln Mar qtr profit.
newsitem.headline: Citibank NZ posts NZ$3.17 mln Mar qtr profit.

text.p: Citibank NA New Zealand reported a NZ$3.17 million profit after tax in the March quarter, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Monday.
Its first quarter figure compared with $2.07 million to March 31 in the same 1996 quarter.

Citibank's quarterly banking disclosure document showed interest revenue of $32.04 million, down on $37.72 million in the quarter last year because of the sale of government stock used as a hedge. Net interest income was therefore also down at $6.85 million, from $11.74 million.
Recovery of doubtful debt was up on 1996, at $974,000 from a previous expense of $206,000, while impaired assets fell to $2.15 million, from $3.94 million.
The profit amounted to 0.9 percent of average total assets, from 0.55 percent, compared with 1.41 percent and 1.37 percent for United States ultimate holding company, Citicorp.
Total assets were $1.47 billion, from $1.44 billion.
Lending, advances and lease finance was $1.23 billion, compared with $1.05 billion last year, and residential mortgage lending was $335.91 million.
The bank's immediate parent, Citibank NA, has long term debt rated Aa3 by Moody's and AA- by Standard & Poor's. The same rating applies to Citibank New Zealand.
